command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP: backup fstab"
sudo -n cp -a /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "STEP: remove any pre-existing /tmp or /dev/shm lines to avoid duplicates"
sudo -n sed -i -E '/^[^#].*[[:space:]]\/tmp[[:space:]]/d; /^[^#].*[[:space:]]\/dev\/shm[[:space:]]/d' /etc/fstab

echo "STEP: append hardened entries"
sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab > /dev/null <<'EOF'
tmpfs	/tmp	tmpfs	rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime	0	0
tmpfs	/dev/shm	tmpfs	rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime	0	0
EOF

echo "STEP: show new fstab"
cat /etc/fstab

echo "STEP: mount /tmp from fstab entry"
sudo -n mount /tmp

echo "STEP: remount /dev/shm with new options"
sudo -n mount -o remount /dev/shm

echo "STEP: verify mount options"
findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /tmp
findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /dev/shm

echo "STEP: functional proof - exec bit ignored"
printf '#!/bin/sh\necho SHOULD_NOT_RUN\n' > /tmp/exectest.sh
chmod +x /tmp/exectest.sh
if /tmp/exectest.sh 2>/tmp/exectest.err; then
  echo "FAIL: script executed on /tmp"
else
  echo "PASS: /tmp exec blocked"; cat /tmp/exectest.err
fi

printf '#!/bin/sh\necho SHOULD_NOT_RUN\n' > /dev/shm/exectest.sh
chmod +x /dev/shm/exectest.sh
if /dev/shm/exectest.sh 2>/dev/shm/exectest.err; then
  echo "FAIL: script executed on /dev/shm"
else
  echo "PASS: /dev/shm exec blocked"; cat /dev/shm/exectest.err
fi

echo "STEP: functional proof - setuid bit ignored"
sudo -n cp /usr/bin/true /tmp/setuidtest
sudo -n chmod 4755 /tmp/setuidtest
ls -l /tmp/setuidtest
stat -c '%a %A' /tmp/setuidtest

sudo -n cp /usr/bin/true /dev/shm/setuidtest
sudo -n chmod 4755 /dev/shm/setuidtest
ls -l /dev/shm/setuidtest
stat -c '%a %A' /dev/shm/setuidtest

echo "STEP: cleanup test files"
rm -f /tmp/exectest.sh /tmp/exectest.err /tmp/setuidtest /dev/shm/exectest.sh /dev/shm/exectest.err /dev/shm/setuidtest

echo "DONE"
